summary: TachyonX is publicly described as Consensys Mesh's Web3 founder program, but current 2026 application status is unclear: the official homepage references a 2025 cohort and the linked application form is over quota.

sources.title: Tachyon - Home
sources.supports: Official site says TachyonX invests in Web3 founders, references a 2025 cohort focused on AI and crypto, lists $250,000 investment, immediate program start from admission, weekly 1:1s, and in-person demo day; FAQ text on the same page says application review is paused until fall.

sources.title: FAQs
sources.supports: Official FAQ says TachyonX is powered by Consensys Mesh, includes funding, mentorship, rolling applications, fully remote format, and describes the legacy Tachyon Accelerator as a 12-week program.

sources.title: TachyonX Application Form
sources.supports: The official application link currently displays 'Form over quota' and does not expose a usable application flow.

sources.title: Introducing TachyonX
sources.supports: Official 2023 launch post says TachyonX evolved from the Tachyon Accelerator, uses rolling admissions, provides Consensys Mesh network access and mentorship, and invests $150,000 under stated terms.

notes: Original supplied URL https://mesh.xyz/tachyon/ returned 404; the official Tachyon site is https://tachyon.xyz/.
Because today is 2026-06-09 and the official page still names a 2025 cohort, I did not create a current event record.
The public pages conflict on funding amount: the homepage program bullets list $250,000, while the FAQ and 2023 launch post list $150,000. This needs human review before merging.
The official application form being over quota suggests applications may not be operational despite FAQ language about rolling applications.
